nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address in ERC20
Nested mapping of allowances owner=>spender=>amount in ERC20
Total token supply, increased by mint and decreased by burn
Token name set in ERC20 constructor
Token symbol set in ERC20 constructor
Owner address stored by Ownable, gates privileged functions
Caller address, attacker controllable, used for mint recipient and ownership checks
Block timestamp, miner manipulable, no direct time dependency in this contract
Transaction origin, phishing vector, not used in this contract
Constructor of FlokiNoke that computes totalSupply and mints it to the deployer
Fallback receive function allowing the contract to accept plain ETH with no logic
Internal ERC20 mint creating tokens and increasing total supply
Internal ERC20 transfer moving balances and calling the before-transfer hook
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding caller, recipient and amount to _transfer
Public ERC20 transferFrom spending allowance via SafeMath.sub
Public ERC20 approve setting allowance for a spender
Internal ERC20 approval writing the _allowances mapping
Owner-only function that zeroes the owner, gated by onlyOwner
Owner-only function transferring ownership to a new address
Empty ERC20 hook invoked before every transfer, mint or burn
Initial token mint in constructor crediting the full supply to msg.sender, cannot run again
Accepting ETH via receive with no withdrawal path, permanently locking any sent ether
Local variable in FlokiNoke constructor holding 1 * 1e9 * 1e18
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer
Token amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer
Source address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient of the initial supply
Constructor executes the one-time mint operation
Constructor calls the internal _mint function
Local totalSupply value is passed into _mint as the amount
Computed supply 1e9*1e18 is multiplied and minted, arithmetic sizing
_mint increments _totalSupply via SafeMath.add
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances via SafeMath.add
transfer delegates execution to _transfer
transferFrom moves tokens through _transfer
transferFrom updates allowance through _approve
approve delegates to _approve
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
Hook pattern is invoked by mint flow, empty body, no external call
_transfer reads and writes _balances with SafeMath.sub/add
transferFrom reads allowance from _allowances and subtracts via SafeMath.sub
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances
Deployer msg.sender becomes the mint beneficiary in the constructor
onlyOwner compares _owner to _msgSender (msg.sender) before renouncing
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on msg.sender being the owner
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner state variable
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner state variable
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner
recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer
amount parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer
sender parameter feeds the balance debit in _transfer
account parameter is credited during _mint
spender parameter keys the allowance write in _approve
receive function triggers the payable ETH acceptance operation

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor local totalSupply exists only to feed the one-time mint amount, so fold it into the mint operation
recipient is a transfer-specific parameter fully consumed by the transfer function
amount is a transfer-specific parameter used only for the arithmetic balance update
sender is a parameter that only participates in the internal balance debit logic
spender is a parameter used only to key the allowance write in _approve
newOwner is consumed solely by transferOwnership to set the privileged owner
account is the recipient parameter used only inside the mint function
